verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that Copilot can run code to complete complex calculations and generate graphs. They also describe Analyst for turning raw numbers into insight and attaching data for analysis, which together cover code-driven computed answers and charts on user data. missing for 10: evidence that code-generated downloadable files (e.g., CSV/XLSX exports) are produced, detail on what data inputs the code sandbox accepts, and independent or hands-on corroboration of code execution.
